Subject: New vendor onboarding — PO request and spend cap

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for taking our onboarding. Attached is the completed vendor onboarding form and the initial SKU list. We are ready to go live but need a PO issued so we can schedule the first shipment. A couple quick items: 

- Requested initial spend cap: $75,000 (per onboarding) — however after final SKU mapping the deployment team asks for a temporary increase to $100,000 to cover split SKUs and initial fulfillment variance.
- We noticed the line-item totals in the onboarding spreadsheet won't map 1:1 to your GL. We'll include a sku_split_matrix.csv to explain how one catalog SKU maps to two ledger lines.

Can you provide a provisional PO number so our accounts team can start invoicing? I attached the onboarding_form_PacificSupply.pdf and the SKU spreadsheet.

Thanks,
Emma Hart
Operations Manager
Pacific Supply Co.

- PS-4432-A -> ledger line 4010 (quantity 1)

Emma / team — thanks for the SKU matrix; that's helpful. Procurement decision and next steps: 

- We will issue a provisional PO number today to unblock shipments: PROV#: PS-0091-PROV (Marcus already circulated a stub).
- We can approve a temporary spend-cap increase but not the full $100k requested. Finance has approved a one-time uplift to $95,000 while we observe first-month usage.
- Regarding the duplicated SKU (PS-4432): please preserve both packaging variants as separate ledger lines (4010 and 4011). We'll map both in our GL as separate line items to avoid downstream reconciliation work.

Action items: 
- Emma: confirm acceptance of the $95,000 cap and that your team will invoice against PS-0091-PROV until we issue the final PO.
- Kimberly: can you confirm final PO number and update the spend cap in the billing ledger once Emma confirms?

I'll hold off on generating the final PO until finance confirms the ledger update and we receive Emmas sign-off.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
